decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system builds directly on the firm's office and conference furniture expertise, so it can read the early market response and refine the product with its own development and design capabilities.
Chairs are core upholstery and craftsmanship territory for a premium furniture maker, which gives the firm strong related knowledge to assimilate feedback and improve the family.

Floor cushions made from carpets are more peripheral, but they draw on the firm's textile and rug material know-how and support the flagship rug direction, so management keeps them for now while watching results.
The soft upholstered sofa fits the firm's living-furniture competence, though its mere mention on the website suggests lower priority and a moderate risk of being phased out.
The high standing table extends the firm's table and workplace knowledge and gets its own page, so it is likely retained as part of the flexible-workplace portfolio.
The rug collection is presented as a flagship and focus of the firm's direction, so the firm is building material expertise around it and is very unlikely to drop it.
